Due to a permanent communication blackout zone, no direct flight corridor exists between Station Alpha and Station Beta.
Furthermore, operational protocols mandate that exactly one of the following two flight corridors must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the corridor connecting Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the corridor connecting Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total flight distance for a closed circuit that visits each relay station precisely once before returning to the point of origin.
